3. The first word of line 1 (after the '- ') begins with the letter P, the first word of line 2 begins with B, and the first word of line 3 begins with S.

7. The word 'bottle' (case-insensitive, exact token) may appear at most once.

first words start with P, B, S in order
checks: line count == 3 and no other non-empty text
regex ^- on each line
first-word initial letters P,B,S
no [zZ] anywhere
count of 'double-walled' token == 1 and located on line 2
word count in [25,40]
count of token 'bottle' (case-insensitive) <= 1
